scope: Focused source-only mobile Chromium check. Real Quickrace menu launch and browser-dispatched multi-touch feed the running original motion simulation. Viewport, blur and visibility lifecycle checks are explicitly controlled. No full races, package builds or releases.

checks.name: Touch auto detects a mobile browser and loads all three control images
The lower wheel feeds the original brake/reverse action and moves the kart backwards
The upper wheel accelerates and a held drag gives proportional left and right steering
The separate brake pedal enters the same native handbrake path as Alt
Three simultaneous contacts combine wheel, brake pedal and power-up without releasing each other
Wheel capture continues outside its hitbox and release/cancel cannot leave a held input
Resizing a held wheel clears it until a fresh touch begins
